1.      Welcome and Introduction of BOS Members:  
BOS Chairman welcomed and introduced all the members of BOS.  
2.  Report on Implementation of Autonomy with Respect to Syllabi & Academic
 Regulations for I B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering I and II Semesters (Under 
 R23 Regulations) 
3.  Course Structure and Syllabi for the Courses of III B.Tech. Computer Science and 
 Engineering I and II Semesters (Under R20 Regulations):  
BOS Chairman presented the proposed course structure and syllabi of core courses of II 
B.Tech. Computer Science & Engineering I and II Semesters to the BOS members and 
sought suggestions (ANNEXURE - II). Members were apprised of the Syllabi of other 
courses of B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering. BOS Members made the following 
suggestions for further improvement and approved the course structure and syllabi. 
Members were apprised of the Syllabi of other courses of II B.Tech. Computer Science 
and Engineerin g. Members have appreciated the efforts of Chairman and Internal 
Members of BOS and the Department in framing course structure and syllabi in a best 
possible way. 
(i) Proposed to shift probability and statistics to II -I and Discrete structures and graph 
theory to II-II as probability and statistics is essential for python programming. All BOS 
members approved the proposal. 
(ii) Suggested to address the gaps between course objectives and course outcomes in 
Advanced Data Structures and Algorithms. 
(iii) Suggested to includ e Real time scenario and analytical skill for every lab. All BOS 
members accepted the suggestion so as to meet the requirements of the software industry. 
(iv)  Proposed to include NPTEL courses for online reference for all subjects instead of 
coursera. BOS chairman accepted the proposal 
(v) Suggested to add Real time scenario like attendance management system /Payroll system 
in DBMS lab. BOS chairman accepted to incorporate the suggestions given. 
(vi) Proposed to define rubrics for Community service project 
(vii) Suggested to add edition and year of publication for Text books and reference books. All 
BOS members accepted the suggestion. 
(viii) Suggested for courses such as "Advanced Data Structures and Algorithm Analysis" and 
"Object-Oriented Programming through JAVA" include hands -on experience with 
industry-standard tools and technologies. BOS chairman accepted the suggestion. 
(ix) Suggested to introduce relevant programming environments and IDEs, such as IntelliJ 
IDEA for Java and PyCharm for Python, to align with industry practices. BOS  chairman 
accepted the suggestion. 
(x) Suggested to i ncrease the number of lab sessions or integrate more real -world projects 
into the curriculum to provide students with practical experience. For example, the 
"Artificial Intelligence Lab" could include projec ts involving real datasets and practical 
AI tools like TensorFlow and PyTorch. BOS chairman accepted the suggestion. 
(xi) Suggested to ensure that the curriculum is regularly updated to include the latest 
advancements in technology. For example, the "Database M anagement Systems" course 
could incorporate NoSQL databases like MongoDB and advancements in cloud 
databases. BOS chairman accepted the suggestion. 
 
4. Course Structure and Syllabi for the Core Courses of M.Tech. Computer Science & 
Engineering I, II, III & IV Semesters (Under R24 Regulations)  
 
BOS Chairman presented the proposed course structure and syllabi of core courses of 
M.Tech. Computer Science & Engineering I, II, III & IV Semesters  to the BOS members 
and sought suggestions (ANNEXURE - III). Members we re apprised of the Syllabi of 
other courses of M.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering. BOS Members made the 
following suggestions for further improvement and approved the course structure and 
syllabi. Members were apprised of the Syllabi of other courses  of M.Tech. Computer 
Science and Engineering. Members have appreciated the efforts of Chairman and 
Internal Members of BOS and the Department in framing course structure and syllabi in a 
best possible way. 
(i) Suggested to i ncrease the number of lab sessions o r integrate more real -world 
projects into the curriculum to provide students with practical experience. 
(ii) Proposed to include NPTEL courses for online reference for all subjects instead of 
coursera. BOS chairman accepted the proposal.
